scope: Read-only eligibility check for Phase 50 live Flashscore PBP score-and-side alignment acceptance.
freshness_rule: live tennis event status/is_live and last_seen_at within 2 minutes of the PostgreSQL query
query_source: live PostgreSQL tables events, tennis_point_match_links, tennis_point_history_versions
interpretation: This check does not assert a PBP mismatch. The acceptance cannot be executed against a current live event because none of the recently observed live events has a confirmed Flashscore match link and PBP version.
